title: Decision
description: The shared shape of an operator-facing decision: the chorus DecisionRecord (DECISION-PRIMITIVE.md) with field names aligned to a problem-brief entry, so a brief entry can be derived from it without loss. Chorus-only fields (point, band, sensor, resolution, override, catalog_row) have no brief counterpart and stay in the chorus record.

kind.description: Record kind, when the decision is stored as a file of its own.

point.description: Which decision point, as named in the decision catalog.

catalog_row.description: The DECISION-PRIMITIVE.md catalog row the band came from. Absent means unlisted, which forces band 🔴.

band.description: 🟢 auto-resolve, 🟡 recorded default + async override, 🔴 hard-block. By declared predicate, never inference (D1).

title.description: The decision as a headline. Maps to a brief entry's title.

problem.description: What has to be decided, in one or two sentences. Maps to a brief entry's problem.

brief.description: Why it matters. Maps to a brief entry's brief.

sensor.description: The rule that fired, its anchors, and its outcome.

signal.description: The predicate that was evaluated (mechanical test or persona flag).

evidence.description: Evidence, in the problem-brief evidence shape.

kind.description: What sort of thing is cited. A chorus finding is kind finding with ref '<record>#<Fn>'.

ref.description: The citation: path:line, commit, finding id, ruling id.

note.description: What this citation shows, in one sentence.

solutions.description: The options (DecisionRecord chosen + alternatives). The first is the default and carries recommended: true.

id.description: Short handle, unique within the decision.

recommended.description: The default (🟡) or highlighted default (🔴). Taken from the vote where one exists.

reversible.description: Whether carrying it out can be undone at comparable cost.

summary.description: The option's consequence: what choosing it actually means.

resolution.description: DecisionRecord resolution. in-progress is a self-heal cycle in flight. hard-block: a 🔴 the chorus cannot pass until the operator rules (not the brief's bearing 'escalated', which means not blocking).

override.description: 🟡 only: the one-action override and its cost (D3).

status.description: Same meanings as a problem-brief entry's status.

decision.description: Which option was chosen. Same shape as a brief entry's decision.

chose.description: The id of the chosen solution.

note.description: Why. Never a restatement of an operator ruling — cite it with ruling_ref.

ruling_ref.description: The operator ruling that settled this decision, held by the ruling sink.

entry_ref.description: The brief entry (Q-n) this decision was published as, written back by the root.
